'''Evon''' is a cook for [[Amellia Arene|Amellia]] and [[Jorin Arene]].

==Appearance==
Evon is a fat man with piggy eyes.{{ref/book|5|18}}

==Activities==
When [[Liandrin]] returns to the manor house in [[Amador]], Evon runs in terror.{{ref/book|5|18}} Later, [[Moghedien]] gives a shielded Liandrin to Evon and Amellia to use as a scullery girl.{{ref/book|5|34}}
